text: Based on the provided context, the definition of treatment response varied across studies. In the BIOMIGA trial, patients were stratified according to treatment response after a 3-month treatment cycle with erenumab [1]. In the retrospective single-center study, a clinically meaningful treatment response was defined as a $\ge$ 50% reduction in monthly headache days (MHD) [2], while the REFORM study defined treatment response as a $\ge$ 50% reduction in monthly migraine days from baseline to Weeks 13-24 [3].
